channel.title: MindDividend Shield Safety Guides
channel.description: Safety-first, multilingual guidance for suspicious messages, links, payments, account alerts, and online scams.

item.title: AI deepfake scam checker guide
item.description: Check voice clones, synthetic video, fake executives, and family-emergency impersonation before sending money or sharing a code.

item.title: Romance scam checker guide
item.description: Pause before sending money, crypto, intimate material, or account details to an online relationship or private contact.

item.title: Investment scam checker guide
item.description: Check crypto pitches, trading platforms, guaranteed returns, withdrawal fees, and payment pressure before sending money.

item.title: Online shopping scam checker guide
item.description: Verify unfamiliar stores, marketplace sellers, discounts, payment requests, delivery promises, and refund routes before buying.

item.title: Online job scam checker guide
item.description: Spot fake remote jobs, upfront fees, crypto tasks, reshipping schemes, fake recruiters, and requests for sensitive information.

item.title: Fake bank text message guide
item.description: Verify suspicious bank alerts without using the text message link, phone number, or request for a password or one-time code.

item.title: Fake package delivery text guide
item.description: Check delivery alerts, redelivery fees, tracking links, and payment requests through a known retailer or carrier account.

item.title: Suspicious website checker guide
item.description: Check an unfamiliar website safely before signing in, paying, downloading, or trusting a link.

item.title: Scam message checker guide
item.description: Review pressure, money, identity, secrecy, link, and code signals in a suspicious message before you click, pay, or reply.

item.title: Suspicious link checker guide
item.description: Inspect a suspicious link without opening it, verify the real domain, protect private session links, and choose safer next steps before clicking or paying.

item.title: Phone scam checker guide
item.description: Pause before calling back an unexpected number, sharing a verification code, moving money, or trusting caller ID.

item.title: QR code scam checker guide
item.description: Inspect unexpected QR codes in messages, packages, signs, invoices, and payment requests before scanning, signing in, or paying.

item.title: Recovery scam checker guide
item.description: Check unexpected refund, tracing, legal, bank, or recovery-agent messages after an earlier loss, and never pay an upfront recovery fee.

item.title: Why scam messages feel urgent
item.description: Understand urgency, authority, and secrecy signals before a suspicious message pushes you to click, pay, reply, or share information.

item.title: MindDividend Shield free global scam checker
item.description: Pause before clicking, paying, replying, sharing a code, or giving remote access. Use the free first-pass checker without entering sensitive information.

item.title: Global safety guide directory
item.description: Find safety-first scam message, phishing email, job scam, delivery scam, reporting, and clicked-link recovery guides in thirteen languages.

item.title: Start with a safer first check
item.description: A calm starting point for suspicious texts, emails, social messages, payment requests, account alerts, and delivery notices.

item.title: WhatsApp scam message checker guide
item.description: Warning signs for urgent WhatsApp messages, fake support, impersonation, payment requests, and requests for verification codes.

item.title: Phishing email checker guide
item.description: Check sender pressure, links, attachments, payment requests, and account warnings before responding to a suspicious email.

item.title: How to report an online scam to police
item.description: Find official reporting routes across nineteen countries and regions, including refreshed India and Mexico government entry points, with reminders to verify channels and protect sensitive evidence.

item.title: What to do after clicking a scam link
item.description: A calm recovery checklist for accounts, devices, payments, evidence, and follow-up after opening a suspicious link.
